MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 10
   C. 81
   D. 9

2. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

4. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 6x

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 77

8. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

9. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

10. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27

11. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

12. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
